canonicality.rule: indexer, snapshot and stream heads must never lead the canonical head and may lag it by at most three blocks

freshness.rule: V14 clients must surface freshness metadata and treat data outside the qualified bound as stale

reorg.rule: replacement events must expose distinct affected/replacement record IDs and historical lookup must resolve the replacement record

client_rules: V14 must consume V13 read surfaces and must not invent protocol state from local UI assumptions
V14 must preserve canonical subject identifiers and record IDs
V14 must surface stale/reorg/replacement state explicitly
V14 must not mutate execution, custody, mint, burn or settlement state through read APIs
